schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Rust crates in one weekly pull request. Cargo.toml names major.minor ranges, so most updates only refresh Cargo.lock.
The estate-baseline commit of the CI gate is a custom manager below; the github-actions manager leaves it alone.
The scanners action and the publication gate move together.

prBodyNotes: Set `ZOLA_SHA256` in `site/tools.env` to the SHA-256 of the new `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` tarball: the site workflow refuses the download until it matches.
Set `CARGO_DENY_SHA256` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to the SHA-256 of the new `x86_64-unknown-linux-musl` tarball: CI refuses the download until it matches.

packageRules.description: Wrangler (site/package.json) runs with the Cloudflare deploy token in the site workflow, so its updates are merged by hand: the estate preset would auto-merge npm devDependencies.

customManagers.description: The estate-baseline commit of the scanners action and of the publication gate in CI.
